Book by Rex Fraction
Autonomous Semantic Warfare: A Field Manual for
Meaning in the Age of Platform Capture by Rex
Fraction is a 2026 book that argues modern
conflict occurs between incompatible "“meaning-
systems" mediated by AI-driven platforms, not just
ideologies. It proposes a framework for analyzing
this “ontological collision," where platforms extract
meaning, and introduces concepts like
"autonomous semantic agents" and operators
(Negation, Capture, Retrocausal Validation) to
understand how AI-driven systems alter reality and
influence human cognition. The book is part of the
"Pocket Humans" series from New Human Press and
is associated with the Crimson Hexagon project,
which builds infrastructure for meaning outside of
extractive systems. 2
Key Concepts
¢ Semantic Warfare: Conflict fought over the meaning of
information, not just physical territory. @
e Platform Capture: Social media and other platforms are
not neutral but are systems that extract value from
human meaning-production.
¢ Ontological Collision: The core conflict is between
